program_target: Measure whether OpenEvo can improve WebShop score, speed, or execution quality on Qwen2.5-3B, then compare the stabilized route with a separately frozen SEED baseline.
scientific_question: Can Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct convert its own fresh successful WebShop trajectories into an OpenEvo SD-LoRA update that improves held-out closed-loop behavior?
hypothesis: If Qwen2.5-3B can produce enough parser-valid, non-zero-reward trajectories on train-only tasks, replaying those complete self-generated trajectories should improve fresh-task behavior over the frozen BASE under the same evaluation contract.
independent_variable: self-generated successful trajectory replay versus no adapter

route_decision.current_evidence: H0 established bounded natural success, while H1.11/H1.28 did not establish fresh-task transfer from externally selected or oracle-labeled states.
route_decision.fallback_route: If the Qwen2.5-3B capability gate fails, stop this self-generated route. A separate GPT/OPSD bootstrap may be registered only after an exact GPT trajectory manifest, train/evaluation split, teacher source hash, and privileged-context boundary are available; do not substitute Qwen14B or an online endpoint silently.
route_decision.capability_gate: Proceed to training only if at least two train task identities yield qualified self-generated episodes and at least eight qualified episodes in total.

arms.SELF-EVOLUTION: one rank-4 OpenEvo SD-LoRA adapter trained only on qualified Qwen2.5-3B self-generated success episodes from the train split

train_panel.additional_tasks: four deterministic fresh train-only tasks selected by the materializer
train_panel.selection_rule: known H0 natural-success tasks plus four new train-only tasks; all evaluation tasks are disjoint
train_panel.qualification: identity_ok and trace_complete and no parser/fallback/error and final_task_score > 0

evaluation_panel.tasks: eight deterministic fresh tasks selected after excluding all versioned task identities and train tasks

seeding_and_comparison.h1_29_role: route-feasibility and fresh-task transfer gate; no SEED arm is mixed into this causal panel
seeding_and_comparison.h1_30_role: separate matched OpenEvo-versus-SEED comparison after H1.29 produces a valid route or a preregistered GPT/OPSD route

frozen_comparison_contract.task_ids: same frozen task manifest for both methods
frozen_comparison_contract.rollout_seeds: same frozen seed list for both methods
frozen_comparison_contract.model_revision: same Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct revision when the SEED implementation supports it; otherwise mark the comparison non-comparable
frozen_comparison_contract.invalid_attempt_policy: report runtime/parser/identity failures separately and never hide them inside task score

speed: median valid episode wall time seconds
metrics.win_rule: OpenEvo is a candidate winner only if paired comparison on the frozen manifest is positive on at least one prespecified metric, with method identity and invalid-rate receipts; this is not a claim until independent rerun or uncertainty analysis is complete.

seeding_and_comparison.seed_source_boundary: SEED runtime, weights, and private server assets are not copied into this repository; the future H1.30 manifest must record an exact public source/revision or an auditable external artifact hash.

primary: qualified self-generated train episodes by task identity

positive_rule: The capability gate passes, and SELF-EVOLUTION has a positive aggregate paired score delta over BASE plus positive mean score on at least two complete task identities; this remains a route result and does not open Q3 without independent confirmation.
negative_rule: If the capability gate fails, classify self-evolution as data-starved and stop; if training succeeds but the held-out paired delta is non-positive or task-local, retain the negative result and do not sweep rank/LR/epoch/prompt.
invalid_rule: Exclude runtime/parser/identity failures from scientific denominators; repair only provenance/runtime faults before a fresh preregistered group.
contamination_rules: train and evaluation task identities are disjoint
evaluation outcomes and traces never enter the self-generated dataset
only Qwen2.5-3B outputs from train tasks may enter the self-generated dataset
no teacher, oracle, memory, retrieval, prompt change, or action post-processing during evaluation
one formal adapter training run and no retry after valid completion

resource_budget.parallel_policy: eight UUID-bound sibling containers for train harvest and each evaluation wave; no duplicate occupancy

tracking.offline_fallback: only after exact online initialization/upload failure is captured with error and spool hash

claim_boundary: H1.29 can establish only self-generated data sufficiency and a bounded fresh-task route result. It cannot claim Q3, H2, ordinary-LoRA superiority, retention, transfer, SEED superiority, or GPT/OPSD equivalence. The SEED win target belongs to a later matched H1.30 comparison.
next_gate: CPU tests and manifest/materializer audit must pass before formal task consumption is enabled.
